_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score at 38 sits at Denial's ceiling with a 3% historical break rate over 7 days — this is a coil where HOLD is the statistically honest call, and the analyst's invalidated_if conditions (VIX >75, DXY >102, negative funding) are closer to triggering than the confirmed_if conditions (ETF flows positive, stablecoin growth >50).
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward-calls Disbelief (illegally 2+ rungs ahead) with HOLD direction while narrative implies a bullish reversal; the judge overrides the phase call to Anxiety (Denial -1) as the legal adjacent rung if macro fear reasserts, but anchors direction at HOLD given coil statistics.
